# Villupuram Developer — Comprehensive Documentation

> Full specification and technical capabilities of Villupuram Developer web application agency.

## Overview
Villupuram Developer is a full-service digital software studio located in Villupuram, Tamil Nadu. We build modern, mobile-first, search-engine-optimized web applications with modern aesthetics and top-tier performance scores.

## Technology Stack
- Frontend Framework: React 19, Vite 8, Rolldown
- Styling & Aesthetics: Modern Vanilla CSS with Custom Design Tokens, CSS Grid, Glassmorphism, and GPU-accelerated micro-animations
- Iconography & Visual Assets: Lucide React, optimized WebP imagery, inline SVG graphics
- Performance Targets: 100/100 Lighthouse Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO
